title: Kavanozlar

characters.MOM: a mother in her sixties with grey hair in a low bun, wearing a dusty rose cardigan
characters.SON: a young man of about thirty with short brown hair and a short beard, wearing a navy blue coat

scenes.text:
Annenin evinden neden
hiçbir zaman eli boş dönemiyorsun?
scenes.prompt: In a warm kitchen on an autumn morning, {MOM} lines up glass jars of jam, pickles and a wrapped pastry on the wooden table next to an open travel bag, soft window light.

scenes.text:
Sen "Gerek yok anne" dersin,
o duymamış gibi yapar.
scenes.prompt: In the hallway of a small house, {SON} stands by the door in his coat shaking his head with a smile, while {MOM} on the right walks toward him holding a cloth bundle.

scenes.text:
Kavanozun biri hep
bir kazağın arasına saklanmış çıkar.
scenes.prompt: In a small city apartment at night, an open travel bag on a bed with a folded wool sweater and a glass jar of jam peeking out between the clothes, warm lamp light, rain on the window. No people.

scenes.text:
Çünkü o seninle gelemiyor;
kendini kavanoza koyuyor.
scenes.prompt: At night in a small city apartment, {SON} sits alone at a kitchen table with the jar of jam and a slice of bread in front of him, looking at the jar with a soft smile, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Bir dahaki sefere hepsini al.
Bunu kavanozlarla dönen birine gönder.
scenes.prompt: On an autumn evening at the garden gate of a small house, {MOM} waves goodbye while {SON} walks away carrying a heavy bag, both smiling, golden leaves falling.

caption:
Kavanozlar geldi mi?

Annen o kavanozlara biraz da kendini koyar. 🤍

Bunu annesinin kavanozlarıyla dönen birine gönder.
